verdict.rationale: Lambda documents a REST Cloud API with an OpenAPI spec for creating and managing Cloud resources. It covers instance launch with cloud-init and custom base images, workspace endpoints, and support-ticket webhooks, so a substantial programmatic surface exists. However, several workflows are documented only through the console: reserving 1-Click Clusters, creating firewall rules on the Firewall page, viewing usage, and generating SSH keys. Nothing establishes full UI parity, and the unofficial community MCP/CLI wrapper earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented API coverage for 1CC reservation, firewall rules, usage/billing data and SSH key generation, an explicit API-UI parity statement, and independent hands-on corroboration.
